# Debugging and verification

Use Execution Guard root-cause debugging on failures. Run relevant tests and quality checks. For user-visible work, prefer the repository's current browser workflow; capture what was actually observed and mark unavailable runtime/browser checks unverified. Produce the implementation handoff contract.

Do not claim browser behavior from static inspection. Exit through Execution Guard Prove It.
